articleTitle: A Hybrid CNN and Transformer Model for Chest X-Ray Classification: Toward Accurately Diagnosing COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Recent studies have employed computer vision and convolutional neural network based methods to automate and enhance the diagnosis based on chest X-ray. However, these approaches demand significant computational resources and other intricate techniques to produce results.In order to reduce the model parameters and improve the diagnostic accuracy of COVID-19, we proposed a framework based on lightweight CNN and vision transformer. This framework leverages two key components: the MBConvFusion module and the mobile inverted bottleneck convolution block. By introducing the MBConvFusion module, which connects three MBConv modules in parallel, our model achieves outstanding accuracy of 98.75% with only 1.4 million parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Technical Characteristics of Balance Type Twin-screw Compressor Based on Advantage Structure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: This paper introduces the methods of constructing the twin-screw compressor load characteristics which were in the background of the basic performance parameters of the exhaust pressure and the exhaust volume, and some relevant data and charts from them, on the basis of the definition of the load characteristics of twin-screw compressor, the principle of classical mechanics and mechanical work and the traditional theory of the compressor was applied, based on the advantage of balance type twin-screw compressor’ structure; then, the specific expression, the way of expression, the theoretical data and the conclusion analysis of the advantaged characteristics of the exploratory research on the excavation of the technical characteristics of the advantaged structure were given. They can provide a theoretical basis for the advantaged characteristics and value of balance type twin-screw compressor.

articleTitle: FCNN-GraspNet: a steamlined neural network for robotic grasp detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: With the development of robotics, generative grasp detection network based on deep learning has become a hot research direction in the field of robotic arm grasping. The existing learning-based grasp detection methods usually cannot guarantee high accuracy while keeping their network models small. To address this issue, in this paper, a lightweight grasp detection neural network FCNN-GraspNet is proposed. It is designed using the encoder-decoder structure in a neural network By inputting an n-channel multi-modal image, a generate pixel-level grasping detection frames. In the encoding layer, partial convolution is used to extract the features of the image, and in the decoding layer, CSPBlock and upsampling network are designed to predict the grasping pose for the grasping generation head network. Its network training parameter is only 0.947million. The experimental results show that this network achieves up to 99.3% accuracy on the Cornell dataset and 92.7% accuracy on the Jacquard dataset. Meanwhile, Achieved an accuracy of 83.7 in 200 grasping experiments in a simulated environment.

articleTitle: Implementation of a High-Precision Secondary Radar Tracking Algorithm Based on Single-Pulse Tracking Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of high tracking accuracy and high implementation efficiency in the dynamic tracking and positioning process of a certain type of secondary radar, a search-track model based on single-pulse tracking technology is proposed. Firstly, a wide beam is used to scan the entire area in a short time to obtain the approximate location of the target. Then, on the basis of this location, a narrow beam is used for target tracking. During narrow beam tracking, real-time attitude information and measurement information are converted to Cartesian coordinates through coordinate transformation calculations, and $\alpha$-$\beta$ filtering is performed to finally achieve closed-loop tracking. This equipment can achieve high-precision dynamic tracking at the sub-milliradian level in terms of angle.

articleTitle: Variable Scale Gesture Recognition: A Dataset and Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Dynamic gesture recognition plays an important role in natural human-computer interaction. Gesture image sequences can express more complex interaction intentions. Currently, the majority of dynamic gesture recognition algorithms are trained using fixed-length gesture sequences. However, the rate, amplitude, and angle of gestures differ across individuals, which presents a challenge to the effectiveness of existing dynamic gesture recognition algorithms. To address this challenge, we propose a variable scale gesture dataset. This dataset contains six types of dynamic gestures with different sequence lengths. In the experiments, we utilized major algorithms, including Two-Stream, C3D, CRNN and I3D, to test and evaluate their performance. Although current algorithms have been able to achieve high recognition rates for fixed-length sequences, they are unable to directly recognize variable-length sequences. The dataset includes four types of static gestures that can be used for dynamic gesture keyframe recognition and start/stop frame determination. The dataset proposed in this paper is expected to advance research in variable scale gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing on a Bird-inspired Flapping Wings Robot Combined with LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The flapping wing robot (FWR), inspired by avian aerodynamics, is a distinct category of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Different to general UAVs, such as quadcopters, FWRs are featured by their superior aerodynamic capabilities, minimal noise generation, inherent stealth, and lower energy consumption. As a result, they are rapidly becoming vital tools in a variety of civilian and military activities including environmental monitoring, disaster detection, search and rescue operations, ecological conservation, and military manoeuvres. Our study introduces the comprehensive integration of a light detection and ranging (LiDAR) module, serving as a visual perception device, with a large FWR that is equipped with 2-meter, two-segment wings. Based on this setup, the geospatial information of targeted area is captured and compared to the existed topographic data.

articleTitle: Fatigue Life Analysis of the Grabber Working Device under the Compound Action
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In this study, the problem that it is difficult to predict the fatigue life of the grabber working device under the compound action is studied by establishing virtual prototype simulation. Firstly, the boom and the bucket of the grabber are taken as the research targets, and the oil pressure of each cylinder and hydraulic rotary motor are measured during the arm lifting and rotation phase, where is the highest force and the most complex movement. Secondly, in order to acquire the force at each hinge point of the working device, the model of the grabber is established in Solidworks, ANSYS APDL is used to create the flexible body of boom and bucket, and the grabber rigid-flexible coupling virtual prototype is established with ADAMS for dynamic simulation. Finally, the fatigue life simulation of the grabber’s boom and bucket is carried out by ANSYS nCode DesignLife. The results show that the position most prone to fatigue failure is the transition of the bucket upper plate and the connection between the cylinder support on side a of the boom and the side plate, as well as the life of these position, which provides the basis for the optimization design of the grabber working device later.

articleTitle: Design And Trial Production Of Flying Flowers Detection And Information Processing Device Basis On Line Scan Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: To address the inefficiency and error-prone nature of manual weighing methods used to detect the presence of short fibers, commonly known as “flying flowers,” in the acetate fiber tow used to make cigarette filter rods, a line scan camera-based visual inspection system was developed. This system operates on an open flying flower integrated machine, where the tow is subjected to specified speed ratios, and roll pressures on the roll, resulting in the opening and stretching of the tow. However, due to factors such as fiber wear and breakage, a certain amount of short fibers are produced. The newly designed visual inspection system aims to overcome the limitations of manual weighing methods and provide improved efficiency and accuracy in detecting the flying flower. This paper mainly focuses on presenting the comprehensive design scheme of the system, as well as discussing the structural composition and working principles of each component. The main objectives achieved include the automation of microfiber scene capture after manual sampling on the production line, the implementation of encoding, storage, reading and control of shooting light sources, and the successful development of Feihua intelligent detection system. In addition, through these information processing and development efforts, significant progress has been made in key technologies related to Feihua intelligent detection.

articleTitle: Defect Detection of Photovoltaic Panel Electroluminescence Image Based on YOLOv7-SE-DS-NWD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Solar energy serves as a representative of renewable energy sources, and defects in photovoltaic panels are crucial factors affecting the solar power generation system. To enhance the power generation efficiency of solar energy, a defect detection algorithm for electroluminescence images of photovoltaic panels based on YOLOv7-SE-DS-NWD is proposed. First, in YOLOv7 (you only look once version 7), extended efficient layer aggregation networks (extended efficient layer aggregation networks, ELAN added the squeeze-and-excitation (SE) attention mechanism to make the model more focused on useful channel information. Then, the convolution module in the detection head of YOLOv7 is replaced with Distribution Shifting Convolution (DSConv). In the detection head, the regression loss function replaces IoU (intersection over union) with the Normalized Gaussian Wasserstein Distance (NWD) to enhance small target detection capability. According to experimental results, the improved YOLOv7 algorithm exhibits a 1.4% increase in detection accuracy compared to the original YOLOv7. This enhancement addresses missed and false detections of defects in electroluminescence images of photovoltaic panels, optimizing the overall defect detection performance for photovoltaic panel applications in power plants.

articleTitle: HexHeAd: 6D Head Pose Estimation Based Visual Focus of Attention Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: This paper proposes a visual focus of attention detection method based on the user’s 6D head pose estimation, which determines the content of the observer’s visual focus of attention according to the current visual attention focus range of the observer. The system detects the observer’s current head posture and uses continuous tracking of the direction of interest to determine when the observer’s visual focus of attention is drawn to a specific location and content. Context-based visual focus of attention span is used as an approach to detect the level of interest an observer has in a particular content. Then, according to the level of interest of the observer, a visual focus of attention-based interaction channel can be established, and the observer’s feedback on specific content can be accumulated to obtain the relevant preferences of the observer and establish a foundation for future interactions. In order to evaluate the method, we conducted an experiment using short video as the target visual focus of attention, and when the observer watched a large screen playing specific content in an open area, the proposed method determined the current visual focus of attention level of the observer, and further discovered the interest of the observer according to the content viewed by the observer. The evaluation results show that our approach has good performance for automatic observer tracking or human-robot interaction.

Index Terms: Center Of The Field Of View

articleTitle: Parameter design and simulation verification of leg hydraulic cylinder for quadruped robot
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In order to realize the walking stability of quadruped robot in different road conditions and improve work efficiency, the parameters of leg hydraulic cylinder of quadruped robot are designed in this paper. According to the geometrical relation of the leg structure, the data relation between the Angle parameter and the length parameter of the hydraulic cylinder in each joint of the robot is obtained, and the stroke parameter of the hydraulic cylinder is calculated. Based on the joint simulation of ADAMS and MATLAB, the calculated hydraulic cylinder parameters are effectively verified through the simulation experiment of foot robot crossing the obstacle. The experimental results show that the hydraulic cylinder on the thigh of the quadruped robot has a larger thrust, while the hydraulic cylinder on the calf has a smaller thrust, but the maximum thrust value of the hydraulic cylinder in the same part is about the same. Therefore, when designing the hydraulic cylinder, the hydraulic cylinder on the thigh and the calf are designed to be the same size respectively, which can meet the stability of the four-legged robot walking in different road conditions.

Author Keywords: joint simulation of ADAMS and MATLAB

articleTitle: Metal surface Feature Fusion for Defect Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Metal sheets have been widely used in various industrial production and production life aspects. However, the surface of metal plates is prone to multiple defects, which affect the electromagnetic characteristics and coating effect of metal plates. Currently, mainstream inspection uses YOLO, PaddleClas, and other methods to detect flat metal surfaces. These algorithms are all very potent in their classification capabilities, but as generalized defect handling algorithms, they cannot be specific to each type of defect in a real problem. In this paper, we propose a multi-information fusion method for defect recognition. We consider both low-level texture features and high-level convolutional features of metal surfaces for defect recognition. We use a convolutional neural network as the main body and add extracted and processed prompts during training. Finally, we test the proposed method extensively on Camshaft and Kaggle metal surface defects datasets, and the experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves a state-of-the-art recognition performance that surpasses previous defect recognition methods.

articleTitle: VREP Platform: A Virtual Reality-Based Human-Computer Interaction Experimental Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The deployment of human-computer interaction (HCI) experimental platforms across various domains is of paramount importance. Presently, conventional HCI platforms continue to be rooted in Personal Computer (PC), exhibiting limitations such as low immersion, reduced real-time responsiveness, and diminished accuracy. In light of these constraints, this research advocates for a Virtual Reality (VR)-based HCI experimental platform, with the aim of overcoming these limitations. The platform seeks to enhance user experiences, evaluate emerging interaction technologies, and facilitate scholarly research. Integrating VR technologies, this platform offers a simulated, realistic interactive environment supporting multimodal inputs. The architecture includes three main components: users, processing, and the computer, with submodules facilitating scene construction, tracking, and connectivity. The platform showcases its potential for immersive interaction through an intelligent collaboration experiment between humans and unmanned aerial vehicles.

articleTitle: The buried target detection system based on unmanned underwater vehicle: Signal processing methods for parametric Ricker wave
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: To promote the development of marine environment monitoring equipment which is adapted to shallow sea environments, a buried target detection system based on parametric acoustic array (PAA) technology deployed in unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) is proposed in this paper. Due to the technical advantages of PAA, this system is small size, light weight and cost-effective. However, the signal processing methods for PAA are more complex than that for linear sonar system because of the nonlinear effect of the sound field of PAA. Therefore, signal processing method for parametric Ricker wave are designed in this paper, including pre-processing and modulation method for transmitter and echo signal processing method for receiver. In detail, carrier-suppressed square root modulation is used to produce Ricker waves in the far field of PAA. CWT-based and STFT-based Synchrosqueezing transforms are proposed to improve time-frequency resolution and thus detection accuracy. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods through simulation.

articleTitle: Development of ballast water control simulation system for solid bulk carriers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: With the advancement of computer technology and intelligent navigation systems, the manual button-operated ballast water handling on bulk carriers has been upgraded to computer system operations. Addressing issues such as the independence of ship stowage calculation computer systems, the absence of interfaces connecting them to the ballast water system, and the inability to dynamically synchronize Calculation ballast water and cargo handling during loading and unloading operations, a virtual simulation system has been developed. This system simulates cargo loading and unloading as well as ballast water operations, serving both training purposes and providing remote ballast water control and intelligent vessel management capabilities. The advantages and applications of this system lie in its ability to enhance the safety and efficiency of ballast water management through computational integration while simultaneously strengthening crew training. Increase and improve the safety of the ship in operation, make the crew more realistic training related operations, and improve the integrity of the crew training program.

articleTitle: A bullet hole recognition method based on visual detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Shooting Intelligent Detection System has important applications in the military industry. Existing target shooting systems mainly face problems such as high cost, complex operation, and poor environmental adaptability. Considering the above limitations, in this paper we propose a fast, low-cost, and easy-to-deploy bullet hole recognition algorithm based on visual detection, which mainly consists of four parts: image preprocessing, extraction of target center, bullet hole extraction and ring value determination. In the process of bullet hole extraction, a method for segmenting effective target surface is proposed to cope with the problem of off-target bullet holes. Our method can not only accurately localize the bullet holes, but also obtain the exact ring value at that location. In addition, due to the robust adaptability of our method, it can even be applied to outdoor scenarios.

articleTitle: Application and algorithm research of proportional directional valve in speed control circuit of underwater hydraulic motor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In this paper, proportional directional valve is selected as the control element in the speed control circuit of underwater hydraulic motor, and a complete set of control circuit is designed. The control circuit can realize the locking of underwater motor, and can adjust the opening and direction of proportional valve according to the position information of external load, so as to realize the closed-loop control of motor. To handle both the unknown external disturbances and parameter uncertainties of the hydraulic motor system and obtain finite-time convergence, a novel control method combining terminal sliding mode control and improved adaptive finite-time disturbance observer is adopted in this work. The stability of the controller is proved by the Lyapunov stability theory and verified by a numerical simulation example. A numerical example indicates that the proposed control method possesses satisfying dynamic characteristics and high accuracy against disturbances and system uncertainties, showing appealing and competitive characteristics compared to other control technologies.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional SAR target reconstruction based on pix2pix and pixel2mesh
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Tomographic synthetic aperture radar (SAR) is one type of technology that can achieve three-dimensional (3D) high-resolution imaging of targets. However, it requires collecting and processing a large amount of data each time, which is time-consuming and costly. The 3D reconstruction technology based on deep learning can directly reconstruct targets from two-dimensional (2D) SAR images, requiring only sufficient data to train the network. In this paper, a 3D reconstruction network which combines pixel-to-pixel (pix2pix) with pixel-to-mesh (pixel2mesh) is proposed to reconstruct 3D SAR targets from SAR images. The pix2pix is used to generate an optical image corresponding to the input 2D SAR image, and then the pixel2mesh is used to complete the 3D reconstruction from the generated 2D optical image. Experimental results on the simulated and real SAR datasets verify that the combined network achieves good 3D reconstruction results.

articleTitle: Arduino-based Omnidirectional Mobile Intelligent Vehicle Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of road traffic congestion and poor autonomous movement in a narrow space, this paper develops a set of omnidirectional mobile intelligent vehicle control system based on Arduino and using Mecanum wheel. The system allows the vehicle to move autonomously in a narrow space, with intelligent obstacle avoidance, steering and U-turn functions. We used the assembled cart to write the corresponding program and debugged the control parameters of some motors and servos to improve the various tasks of the cart.

articleTitle: An Unknown Risk Analysis and Evaluation Method for Distribution Edge Computing Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Distribution edge computing networks require robust risk analysis and evaluation, especially for unknown attacks. This work addresses unknown risk analysis using the Bayesian hazard graph, proposing an algorithm tailored to the context of edge computing networks. The algorithm calculates unknown risks using a noise model and incorporates the CVSS scoring standard to create a conditional probability table. It continuously updates probability distributions with known information and real-time feedback, making it well-suited for distribution edge computing networks.

articleTitle: Small target detection in aerial photography based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Considering the characteristics of large numbers, dense distribution, and complex background of small goals in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) aerial graphics, target detection of small objects approach based on modified YOLOv5s is designed. To address the issue of inadequate utilization of features across different scales in the original network, a multi-scale feature fusion approach is devised to comprehensively extract features and enhance their utilization. The method combines the adaptive spatial feature fusion (ASFF) module and an additional small object detection layer, which is used to learn fused spatial weights for the feature map at each scale and fully extract the features. The improved YOLOv5 highlights important information features during feature fusion. Experimental findings on the public dataset VisDrone show that the mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf> and mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50:95</inf> of the improved network is 41.3% and 23.7%, which are 7.2% and 4.9% higher than those of the original YOLOv5s, respectively. The visualization experiment further verifies the improved algorithm can increase the detection accuracy of dense small targets.

articleTitle: Online Fine-tuning Method for Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Model Based on Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: As artificial intelligence methods play an increasingly important role in the digital transformation of power grids, when applied in power grid scenarios, these methods face problems such as the inability of models to adaptively deploy data distribution changes, slow response speed, inability to ensure data security on the side, limited computing power on the side, and uneven distribution of computing resources. This method proposes a novel fine-tuning framework based on cloud-edge collaboration to address these issues. This method utilizes reinforcement learning to segment the model, discarding unreliable samples collected on-site to fine-tune the model’s fine-tuning parameters. Finally, validation was conducted on the application scenario of detecting violations in the power grid, and the experimental results show the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: An Improved Robust ClusterGAN with the Perturbation Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Generative adversarial networks (GAN) based deep clustering has achieved remarkable success in both underlying feature representation and cluster assignment. However, in these models, the local structure is easily destroyed by the clustering loss. Moreover, the clustering network is vulnerable to attack, and a small perturbation in the latent space will generate different clustering results. In this paper, an improved robust ClusterGAN model with the perturbation attack is presented. The GAN is trained along with an explicit inverse-mapping network regarding a clustering-specific loss. In addition, a reconstruction network is designed to ensure effective feature representation with the local structure preservation. Finally, a perturbation attack network for noise perturbation is combined to heighten the robustness of the encoder and further promote the clustering performance. Experimental results on real-world datasets verify the efficiency and superiority of the presented model in contrast to the existing GAN-based deep clustering methods.

articleTitle: System-level calibration for NMRG inertial navigation system considering the influence of magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: To address the problem of gyroscope being affected by external magnetic field fluctuations, especially for nuclear magnetic resonance gyroscope (NMRG), a system-level calibration method considering the influence of magnetic field is proposed. The method is based on a 39-dimensional Kalman filter, and except for the geomagnetic field, no additional external magnetic field is required. The simulation results show that this method can calibrate all basic error factors and gyro magnetic field coefficients simultaneously. And the navigation experiment shows that this method can increase the navigation accuracy by 84.9%.

articleTitle: Research of robot-assisted puncture navigation based on 3D reconstruction images
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Aiming at the current traditional tumor puncture and interventional surgery, there are problems such as the inability to directly observe the complex interior of the organ, hand-eye coordination, and easy to lose direction, etc., a robot-assisted puncture navigation system as shown in Fig. The robot can complete the navigation of the puncture needle and assist the doctor in completing the surgery under the drive of the navigation software. The navigation system is mainly composed of a robotic puncture system, an electromagnetic localization system, and an upper computer system. In this paper, the CT 3D reconstruction software is firstly designed and integrated into the platform of the assisted puncture navigation system. The alignment technology of the preoperative assisted puncture navigation system is investigated based on the platform. The puncture error is verified to be less than 3mm through experiments, which verifies that the navigation system is reliable and has high accuracy, and it can meet the requirements of surgical use.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of OFDM with Multi-mode Index Modulation in Bandlimited Low-pass VLC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In this paper, the performance of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) with multi-mode index modulation (MMIM) in bandlimited low-pass (LP) visible light communication (VLC) systems is evaluated. Specifically, we investigate and compare two techniques for LP effect mitigation, i.e., discrete Fourier transform (DFT) spreading and subblock interleaving. It is shown by the simulation results that DFT spreading outperforms subblock interleaving in terms of bit error rate (BER), but subblock interleaving can enable multi-user communication via orthogonal subblock division multiple access.

articleTitle: Optimized Object-aided SLAM for robots Based on Shufflenetv3 and Relocalization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Autonomous mobile robots have experienced rapid development over the past few years, and real-time object detection and localization are considered to be their basic capabilities. In order to improve the robot’s object detection and relocalization performance, an optimized object SLAM based on Shumenetv3 and relocalization is proposed. Firstly, an enhanced lightweight object detection model Shufflenetv3 is suggested to be used to obtain the object detection of a specified object or multiple objects in the to-be-tested frame, which provides it with the benefits of quick computation and excellent accuracy. Secondly, the accuracy of relocalization is increased by employing the refined target object-aided technique. Finally, to validate the effectiveness of the improved lightweight target extraction, we evaluate the performance of our method utilizing the Pascal VOC 2012 datasets and compare it with YOLOv5 and YOLO-shufflenetv3 in precision and efficiency. Comparing the proposed method to YOLOv5 and YOLOshumenetv3, these quantitative evaluations demonstrate that it performs well with competitive inference times and the most memory-efficient inference. Additionally, we conduct experiments using a public TUM dataset, and the outcomes showed that our approach is far more reliable and consistent to guarantee robot application.

articleTitle: Source-based disjoint multi-path routing protocol for underwater acoustic networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: As acoustic communication environment is characterized by limited bandwidth, long propagation delay and high bit error rate, different routing protocols have been proposed to address these issues. In this paper, we propose a source-based disjoint multi-path routing protocol for underwater acoustic communication networks. In this protocol, each data packet is routed by the relay node’s cost, which is determined by the initial hop count, the energy consumption, and the packet collision probability. Once the routing path is determined, the path cost will be updated based on the cost of relay nodes and related interference nodes. Through simulation, we demonstrate that the proposed routing protocol significantly improves network throughput, reduces end-to-end delay, and increases packet delivery rate.

articleTitle: STM Topography Image Noise Modeling And Blind Denoising Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Scanning tunneling microscope (STM) is an important instrument for atomic-scale surface research, but its images are susceptible to interference. Periodic noise is one of the most common STM image defect. Due to the randomness of noise in STM images, previous repair methods require image prior and classification, and then use special algorithms to denoising. In this paper, a novel STM blind denoising method is proposed. Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) is used to simulate the noise and construct a pair of data sets, and then Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for denoising. The network can realize the blind denoising of STM noise image without image prior and classification. The proposed method has demonstrated superior denoising effectiveness on STM images compared to other conventional algorithms, as evidenced by ample experimental results.

articleTitle: Preprocessing and Classification of SERS Spectra Using SA-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Current analysis of Surface Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy (SERS) primarily focuses on characteristic peaks, determining the type of Raman spectra by observing the intensity and area information of these peaks. However, using only the information from characteristic peaks cannot fully represent the entire spectrum, especially when the characteristic peaks are not prominent, the feasibility of this method is relatively low. In this paper, we utilize deep learning and propose the SA-CNN algorithm. By denoising and baseline correction for preprocessing, followed by the design of a classification algorithm using convolutional neural network, we output the category of the spectrum. We validate the algorithm through experiments with three types of antibiotic Raman spectra, ultimately demonstrating that SA-CNN can effectively classify spectra.

articleTitle: Research on underwater target detection technology based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Underwater target detection aims to locate and identify targets in underwater scenes, which plays a significant role in the development of the marine economy and environmental protection. However, existing target detection algorithms often cannot meet people’s needs in underwater environments. In this paper, we propose an underwater target classification convolutional neural network (UTC-CNN) based on You Only Look Once Version 8. This network builds a C2f_Squeeze and Excitation module to enhance the feature extraction ability of blurred underwater targets, and adopts Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network to replace Feature Pyramid Network to further enhance the feature fusion capability. The experiments show this model outperforms other target detection models on Underwater Robot Professional Contest 2020 dataset, with mAP0.5 reaching 84.4%, demonstrating the advantages of UTC-CNN in underwater target detection tasks.

articleTitle: OOD-ENS: Cross-Validated Out-of-Distribution Ensemble Detector
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The task of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection aims to identify abnormal test records for preventing the degradation of the performance of a well-deployed deep learning model on abnormal records. Existing studies have developed several state-of-the-art OOD detection algorithms based on sufficiently pre-trained deep neural models on the large-scale data sets provided in advance. However, the performance of existing OOD detection algorithms is sensitive to a small disturbance in a pre-training data set attributing to the overfitting phenomenon of a pre-trained neural model on the pre-training data set. In this paper, we attempt to reduce the effect of the disturbance on an OOD detection algorithm and improve the OOD detection performance through employing a popular model aggregation method. Specifically, we resample multiple training sets from a pre-training data set by using a $K -$fold cross-validation method and aggregate the corresponding multiple OOD base models into a high-performing ensemble OOD model based on a majority-voting technique. The proposed OOD algorithm, named an OOD-ENS algorithm in this study, is a simple yet effective framework to use most of the existing OOD detection algorithms as the prototype of an OOD base model. Extensive numerical experiments on five well-known image data sets are conducted to illustrate the superiority of the proposed OOD-ENS algorithm.

articleTitle: Vision-based mobile robotic grinding path generation for large castings
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Given the numerous drawbacks of manual grinding for castings, the use of robots for intelligent grinding is quickly becoming an unavoidable trend. This paper introduces the design of a grinding robot system for the intelligent grinding of medium and large non-standard castings. The proposed system uses labels to identify and scan the surface that needs grinding, subsequently registering and segmenting the obtained point cloud. From here, it converts the select grinding area into a triangular mesh surface, and maps it onto a parametric domain using the re-parameterization method. The system then plots a path on the plane and maps it back onto the original workpiece, acquiring the final grinding path after necessary tool axis adjustments. The grinding head is then manipulated to perform constant force grinding, employing the PID control. Tests have shown that the system can effectively grind the surface of medium and large nonstandard castings in real-world industrial settings.

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer-Based H∞Control for Flexible Spacecraft Systems Under Deception Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: A disturbance observer-based $H_{\infty}$ composite control method under disturbances and deception attacks is addressed in this paper. Firstly, the control model is constructed. Secondly, a disturbance observer-based $H_{\infty}$ composite controller via linear matrix inequality (LMI) is developed based on a Lyapunov function. Finally, we present simulations to verify the validity of design method.

articleTitle: Platoon Stability for Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control Systems with Communication Delay
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The platoon stability problem of Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC) system with wireless network communication delay is discussed in this paper. From the unidirectional strong coupling characteristics standpoint, the longitudinal system model problem for platoon vehicles equipped with CACC functionality is formulated as the constraints of large-scale discrete interconnected systems with communication delay and correlation properties, in which each vehicle can be set as a control center. After that, by using the partial decomposition method, a large scale systems with strong coupling is divided into the subsystems with unidirectional decoupling. Thus the stability of CACC system for platoon vehicles under communication delay is proved, and the upper limit of communication delay of the platoon is obtained based on Lyapunov function and linear matrix inequality. Finally, simulation analysis demonstrate that the feasibility of the proposed stability results of CACC system with communication delay and vehicle correlation characteristics.

articleTitle: Design of Segmented Boost Constant Voltage Battery Charger Based on Leakage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: High-power lead-acid batteries are widely used in traction motors, where electric forklifts are active in stationary factories with convenient charging, thus lead-acid storage for forklift motors is widely used. The article uses the characteristic that the output voltage of the leakage transformer increases as the current decreases to discuss the characteristics of lead-acid batteries for forklift motors. It employs the low-voltage constant-voltage charging method in the initial stage to develop an intelligent charging device for traction batteries. This method ensures that the charging current curve closely resembles Mas’s optimal charging curve and addresses the issue of high current at the start of charging, which is caused by the deep discharge of the batteries in the intermittent charging method. Additionally, a capacity estimation method is proposed to complement battery aging and cycle count, reducing the capacity error caused by inaccurate measurement of individual current. The experimental results demonstrate that the designed charger adheres to Mas’s optimal charging curve change pattern when charging the battery’s current and the capacity estimation is a close approximation to the actual battery capacity.

articleTitle: Image Defogging Algorithm Based on Semi-Supervised Learning Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: To improve the quality of images acquired by imaging devices in bad weather such as haze, defogging algorithms are widely used to acquire clear images. This paper proposes two distinct image-defogging algorithms, based on semi-supervised learning, to address the issue of the limited performance of deep learning dehazing algorithms when using synthetic hazy images as their current dehazing datasets. To this end, the poor effect of real foggy images applied to network training is addressed. Generative adversarial networks, employed as an unsupervised branch, are initially utilized to introduce real foggy images into the model training and to train the network in an alternating fashion with synthetic datasets. Secondly, in the unsupervised branch, the fog residual K of the fogged image is estimated by AOD-net, and the defogged image is restored to a fogged image by the improved atmospheric scattering model in AOD-net. Finally, this paper compares the SOTS test set in the RESIDE dataset with five classical algorithms. The comparison algorithms in both PSNR and SSIM indicators are outdone by the algorithms proposed in this paper, as demonstrated by the experimental results.

articleTitle: A Cross-layer Security Analysis and Synthesis Method of B5G Base Station in Industrial Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of B5G base stations in the field of industrial internet, the perception and prediction of their security situation have become a current research hotspot. This paper studies the cross-layer analysis and synthesis problem of B5G base stations, and proposes a new Gl-anti-entropy nested weighting method to address the various issues of the existing “subjective-objective parallel weighting” method, such as complex steps and poor interpretability. Based on this, a cross-layer analysis model of B5G base stations is established according to the hierarchical structure of “system-unit-module” in B5G base stations to finally obtain the system-level security degree of B5G base stations. The research results show that the proposed cross-layer analysis and synthesis method of B5G base station in industrial Internet can effectively characterize the system-level security condition of B5G base stations.

articleTitle: An Enhanced ALNS Algorithm Integrated with DQN for Resource Allocation in Space Station Experiment Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: This study investigates the space station experiment scheduling problem considering priorities and multiple types of experiment cabinets. We build a mixed integer programming model to solve this problem. Since the problem is NP-hard, we propose a Large Neighborhood Search algorithm based on Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent. During the Markov Decision Process (MDP), we analyze the learned information and update the information as state. We validated the model and algorithm using small-scale examples and compared it with one of the most popular algorithms, the Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS) algorithm, on large-scale examples. Experiments prove that our proposed algorithm has stronger search capabilities and stability.

articleTitle: Improved TF-LSTM Multi-Step Vehicle Speed Prediction Model Based on LSTM and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The article introduces an upgraded neural network model based on an encoder-decoder stacks, utilizing a Transformer encoder and a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network as the decoder. Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average(ARIMA), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and LSTM were employed as control groups for experimental validation. Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE) were used as validation parameters. Experimental data demonstrates that under multistep prediction conditions, the ED model effectively mitigates the performance degradation trend. In univariate experiments, RMSE and MAE decreased by 0.2 to 4.1 and 0.2 to 1.8, respectively. In multivariate experiments, RMSE and MAE decreased by 0.2 to 4.5 and 0.1 to 2.0, respectively. This affirms that TF-LSTM can more comprehensively unearth nonlinear relationships in multi-input long time series data by capturing high-dimensional temporal and spatial features, thereby enhancing prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Path Planning for Mobile Robots Based on Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Addressing the issues of excessive redundant nodes, non-smooth paths, and low search efficiency in the path planning process of the traditional A* algorithm, this paper proposes an improved Dynamic Expansion Neighborhood A* algorithm for optimal path planning. Firstly, building upon the traditional A* algorithm, the search neighborhood is dynamically expanded by combining the 8-neighbor and 24-neighbor search algorithms, dynamically adjusting the search scope to reduce redundant nodes. Secondly, through modification of the heuristic function, introducing weights, and optimizing the estimation function to enhance path search efficiency. Finally, the obtained path is subjected to smoothing processing to eliminate corner sharp points, improving path smoothness. Simulation results demonstrate that the improved A* algorithm outperforms the traditional algorithm in terms of length, node count, and smoothness of the planned path.

articleTitle: Airborne test switching network status automatic monitoring technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The status monitoring of the airborne test switching network is the key to ensuring the reliable and effective collection of flight test data. To address the issues of protocol inconsistency, high link reliability, and real-time requirements brought about by heterogeneous networks, a state automatic monitoring technology for airborne test switching networks based on SNMP protocol and Pcap data source parsing is proposed. On the basis of analyzing the nodes of the airborne testing network, the author defined and graded the key attributes of the network nodes by studying the data structure of the MIB library of the airborne testing equipment; Monitored the status of onboard switching network nodes through low-level access to collectors and switches; By converting the INET-X data packets of the airborne switching network, real-time access was made to the source data of all nodes such as collectors and switches, and the communication situation of the switching network architecture was analyzed. Finally, automatic access and control of the collector and switch are implemented in a laboratory environment, and the status recognition function of the airborne switching network is verified. The experimental results indicate that the key status information of airborne testing equipment can be monitored in real-time.

articleTitle: Rotary Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometer Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Fourier transform infrared spectrometer is widely used in chemistry, environmental science and other fields due to its fast scanning speed, high resolution and high sensitivity. In this paper, a prototype of Fourier transform infrared spectrometer is built by designing Michelson interferometer, control circuit and host computer. The control circuit communicates with the host computer through high-speed USB. By setting, the prototype resolution up to 6cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, scanning speed up to 100 times/s. The actual spectrum of silicon carbide light source collected by this prototype is basically consistent with the theoretical spectrum.

articleTitle: A study of obstacle avoidance problem for robots based on basic line-circle combinations
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Aiming at the obstacle avoidance path optimization problem for a robot to reach a specified goal point in an area on the same plane, this paper analyzes different path optimization models, and at the same time divides the obstacles into two categories of vertices and no vertices, and divides them into different exclusion zones, and optimizes them according to the goals. The single-objective point shortest path model is divided into three models: no-goal zone vertex, turning radius, and turning center at the vertex shortest path model, and according to the path turning situation is divided into turning once and many times model, and at the same time, the shortest path time model is established and calculated.

articleTitle: Automotive OTA Upgrade Scheme Based on Optimal Difference Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and reliability of the automotive OTA (Over-the-Air) upgrade, and make it more adaptable to the characteristics of the car. In the paper, we propose to use an optimized BSDIFF algorithm to remotely swipe the car. Specifically, the divsufsort algorithm is used in the suffix sequence, and the Zstd algorithm is used in the compression and decompression process to further improve the upgrade speed. Fault-tolerance mechanism and buried point analysis mechanism are also designed to ensure the robustness of the upgrade process. We conducted OTA upgrade simulation experiment on Linux platform. Experiment results show that the proposed combinatorial optimization algorithm can improve the efficiency of ECU remote writing under the bandwidth limitation of vehicle network.

articleTitle: Improvement of mobility spectrum algorithm based on Hall measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Mobility spectrum analysis is a data analysis algorithm based on Hall measurement, which aims to analyze the spectrum of semiconductor carriers. By collecting the semiconductor conductance tensor analysis in the variable magnetic field, the electron and hole transport behavior in the material can be studied. However, the traditional maximum entropy mobility spectrum algorithm has some limitations, such as sensitivity to data noise and uncertainty, and high computational complexity. To solve these problems, this paper proposes two key improvements. Firstly, the entropy information containing probability values is introduced into the change matrix to improve the robustness and accuracy of the algorithm. Secondly, the adaptive step factor is adopted. Through the simulation verification of various situations, the results show that the improved algorithm can not only better deal with noise and uncertainty, but also improve the evaluation indexes such as fitting degree, Gaussian peak parameter and convergence factor under the same number of iterations, which is more meaningful in the material research of semiconductor field.

articleTitle: Research on fire protection system based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Flame detection systems are becoming more and more important in firefighting, and for indoor large space occasions, this paper designs a firefighting system based on computer vision. Combining the knowledge of mass kinematics and fluid dynamics, the trajectory of the firefighting water cannon jet is deduced, and the effect of different parameter conditions on the trajectory is analyzed using MATLAB simulation. The yolov4 flame detection model is trained to achieve accurate detection of the flame, and the coordinate value of the flame center position relative to the upper-left corner of the image is calculated at the same time. Then the horizontal turning angle required for the rotation of the fire gun is calculated according to the coordinate value, and the monocular visual localization technology is used to realize the localization of the fire source in the actual space, and the horizontal distance from the camera to the fire source is calculated. Substituting the horizontal distance into the jet trajectory algorithm can get the pitch angle of the fire cannon under the corresponding range.

articleTitle: An AMR Mapping Method based on High Efficiency Recursive Filtering Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: An AMR mapping method is proposed based on a high-efficiency recursive filtering fusion algorithm. Specifically, this method utilizes the extended kalman filter to combine the data of the mileage measurement and the inertial measurement unit with the lidar calibration, which improves the accuracy of the initial attitude value and solves the problem of high computational complexity, poor real-time performance, and inaccurate attitude estimation at subsequent moments. Physical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method, and the comparison results with the original algorithm are given.

articleTitle: A long-distance small target perception optimization algorithm integrating SRGAN and YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In order to improve the image resolution of long-distance small targets in actual traffic scenes, this study utilized an improved SRGAN reconstruction, which is based on the GAN, and uses the global image feature information extracted by the attention module for image reconstruction, and the image size is normalized on the image pixels, which solves the image reconstruction task. The pixel loss function is constructed to improve the quality of the image by using the robust Charbonnier loss function, At the same time, the traditional YOLO algorithm is improved to lightweight, based on the research results, it can be concluded that, SRGAN and lightweight YOLO algorithms are used to improve the resolution and real-time detection long range targets and small targets, and enhance the perception ability long range targets and small targets in actual traffic scenes.

articleTitle: Design and realisation of a construction robot applied to concrete vibration for box girders
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The growth of industrial intelligence has led to greater automation in numerous sectors. As robots are becoming increasingly prevalent, companies must confront the essential matter of how to employ them to supplant manual labour, ultimately heightening productivity and efficiency. This paper outlines the development of an automated vibration robot comprising a vertical vibration robot cell, a rail-type inclined insertion vibration robot system, and other cells working in collaboration. This paper uses box girder vibration as the foundational framework and conducts field experiments with an automated vibration robot designed for this purpose. The measurements of concrete strength reveal that the automated vibrating robot meets industrial standards, thus verifying its capacity to perform large-scale construction vibration. The potential for substituting human labour with automated robots in large-scale vibration construction is showcased.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Approach for Human-like Driving Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Human-driven trajectories demonstrate superior attributes such as enhanced comfort, stability and energy efficiency compared to traditional trajectory planning methods. This paper introduces an end-to-end trajectory planning methodology imitating human-like driving behaviors utilizing a lightweight SqueezeNet network. Moreover, this approach adds an attention mechanism into the network architecture to further enhance its performance. Primarily, the integration of the attention module serves to augment the network’s capacity in capturing salient visual features. This augmentation is crucial in constructing a network framework explicitly tailored for human-like driving trajectory planning. Secondly, utilizing the attention module strengthens the network’s ability to discern informative image features, thereby refining the network framework for the proposed trajectory planning approach. Furthermore, an empirical comparison with alternative methods demonstrates a higher accuracy in aligning planned trajectories closely with actual values when employing the proposed approach. Particularly noteworthy is the achievement of a 20.4% reduction in energy consumption compared to conventional trajectory planning methods.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Bilateral Semantic Segmentation Network for Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Agricultural robots have experienced rapid development in the past few years, and real-time autonomous moving is considered to be their basic capability. In order to improve the robot’s autonomous transportation performance, a lightweight bilateral semantic segmentation network for agricultural robots is proposed. Firstly, the improved bilateral semantic segmentation network is proposed to realize the segmentation with high precision and efficiency through the aggregation layer. Secondly, a PID adaptive control algorithm is used to control the steering angle of the agricultural robot. Finally, in order to verify the effectiveness of the improved semantic segmentation network, MIoU, the average intersection ratio frequently utilized in semantic segmentation, is used to evaluate the segmentation accuracy. Moreover, the proposed network is used to compare with Fast-SCNN, DeeplabV3+, BiSeNetV1, and BiSeNetV2 algorithms using the cityscape dataset. Experimental results show that the proposed network achieves more accurate segmentation than the above methods and is successfully applied to the agricultural robot in an outdoor environment.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control for Delayed PDE-ODE Coupled Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: This paper introduces a fault-tolerant control strategy for delayed PDE-ODE coupled systems. By using a Lyapunov functional (LF), a fault-tolerant control design is developed by space-dependent linear matrix inequality (SDL-MI) to ensure the exponential stability (ES) for the closed-loop delayed PDE-ODE coupled system. Finally, the effectiveness of the control approach is demonstrated through its application to a hypersonic rocket car (HRC).

articleTitle: Exploring the path of human-robot collaboration decision making on team performance driven by digital technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The application of robots in people’s work is becoming increasingly common, and the deep integration of robots with various industries has changed the traditional work scene and organizational model. However, there are cognitive differences in the mechanisms by which hu-man-robot collaboration works on employee and team performance. Based on this, this study constructs a mediated model of the moderated mediation of human-robot collaboration, team performance, team creativity, and team virtuality based on resource preservation theory and team process theory. The study showed that: 1) human-robot collaboration has a significant positive effect on team performance; 2) team creativity plays a significant mediating role in the relationship between human-robot collaboration and team performance; 3) team virtuality not only moderates the direct relationship between human-robot collaboration and team performance but also further moderates the indirect effect of human-robot collaboration affecting team performance through team creativity. The findings expand on the impact of human-robot collaboration in engineering projects, providing lessons for engineering project team performance management and shifts in organizational change.

articleTitle: Transmissive phase measuring deflectometry system using frequency domain Gamma error elimination algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Transmissive phase measuring deflectometry plays an increasingly pivotal role in lens wavefront measurement, owing to its uncomplicated system structure, expansive curvature measurement range, and commendable versatility. Nevertheless, the Gamma error, stemming from the nonlinear characteristics of the display screen and the camera, has emerged as a critical factor impeding measurement precision. This limitation significantly hampers the accuracy of lens phase coordinate calculation. In this paper, we propose a frequency domain Gamma error elimination algorithm based on linear regression for the transmissive phase measuring deflectometry system. This algorithm effectively mitigates the Gamma error introduced by the display screen and camera within the system. The method is characterized by its universality, rapid execution, and high accuracy. Experimental results substantiate the algorithm’s viability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Extended State Observer and Kalman Filter Based Control for DC-DC Buck Converter Subject to Disturbances and Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Direct current-direct current buck converters are widely used in industrial fields. In practical applications, parameter uncertainty, external disturbances and measurement noise affect the control performance of DC-DC buck converter. To deal with external disturbances and measurement noise in DC-DC buck converter, a control strategy combining extended state observer (ESO) and Kalman filter (KF) is proposed in this paper. The extended state observer is used to estimate the lumped disturbance of the DC-DC buck converter system. However, in order to achieve fast convergence in the control process, the observer chooses a large control gain, which results in severe noise amplification. To this end, the Kalman filter is used to filter the noise. The composite control method proposed in this paper can improve the robustness and voltage tracking performance of DC-DC buck converter. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Co-Designing Body and Behavior via Planning-based Hierarchical Grammatical Evolution
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: An agent’s intelligence tends to benefit from the co-adaption between the body morphology and the behavior policy, aka. embodied intelligence. To create an embodied agent, the joint optimization of the body and the behavior becomes the key problem. To solve that, a popular approach is to use search-based or learning-based heuristics to traverse the morphological space, and optimize a behavior policy for each morphology to evaluate their joint fitness. However, prior works often ignore the relations between body components and modular behaviors, e.g. a mechanical foot can be used to walk, run, kick, etc. To reduce the complexity for embodied intelligence, we come up with a natural idea, that is, to build a mapping from the componentized body to modular behaviors at a lifted abstraction. Based on that mapping, we propose a novel evolutionary computing framework called Hierarchical Grammatical Evolution (HGE). We use the Backus-Naur Form (BNF) to abstract both the body and the behavior space in a modular way, where Behavior Tree (BT) is used to model the behavior policy. Specifically, we leverage the planning-based BT expansion method for further improving the efficacy and efficiency of HGE. Experiments are conducted in a house cleaning scenario and computational test sets, where the results validate the feasibility and scalability of HGE compared with the state of the arts.

articleTitle: An RF Synthesis Method for the UAV Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Based on the broadband requirements of UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle)radar, the characteristics of frequency synthesis, the implementation of waveform generation, the challenges of spatial power synthesis, signal transmission and signal integrity design are elaborated respectively. The frequency synthesis scheme of DDS (Direct Digital Frequency Synthesizer) + hybrid phase-locked synthesis is given, the spatial power synthesis of frequency diverse array antenna is realized, and the optical fiber wave division multiplexing signal transmission is implemented. The scheme realizes the miniaturized and high-density RF synthesis of advanced UAV radar. The paper also prospects the cutting-edge technology and development direction involved in RF synthesis design.

articleTitle: Complex Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on Improved Residual Shrinkage Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Failures of mechanical components are characterized by high concurrency, high coupling, and feature frequency overlapping, etc. To solve the above problems and improve the diagnostic efficiency and accuracy, an improved residual contraction neural network for composite fault diagnosis of bearings is proposed. Null convolution and residual contraction blocks form a feature extraction layer, superimposed multiple contraction blocks form the whole residual contraction network, while migration learning is applied in the method to realize the mapping from source domain to target domain, so that the diagnostic model fault features are shared in the source and target domains, and the experimental results show that: the migration learning algorithm is combined with the DHRSN algorithm, and the composite fault diagnosis in the environment of variable operating conditions reaches 96% or more. Through theoretical deduction and bench test, the correctness and reliability of the improved residual shrinkage network method in the composite fault diagnosis of variable operating conditions are verified, promoting practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Which performs better, linear scanning or the KNN searching algorithm based on 2D grids?
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: The K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm is widely used in navigation, such as traffic management, driverless vehicles, and logistics planning. While it offers powerful instance-based learning, its performance can be influenced by data distribution and distance metric choice, and scalability can be an issue with large datasets. In this paper, we compare KNN with linear scanning in 2D grid-based search algorithms. KNN excels in accuracy, multidimensional feature processing, flexibility, and stepwise optimization, making it a strong choice for efficient and accurate 2D grid data search. Especially when the dimension of the grid is 200 * 200 and the grade is 1, the performance of KNN is 99.70% better than linear scanning. However, we acknowledge that KNN’s performance hinges on distance metric selection, and different metrics may perform differently in various applications. KNN is also sensitive to noise and outliers, which highlights the need for future enhancements and optimizations.

articleTitle: Dynamic reactive power optimization strategies for active distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: In order to improve the utilization of distributed power sources and to cope with a series of challenges including voltage deviation, fluctuation, and poor power quality caused by the uncertainty of distributed power sources and loads, this paper establishes a two-stage robust optimization dynamic reactive power optimization model that includes many controllable devices such as energy storage, distributed power sources, and packet casting capacitors. Firstly, this paper proposes a method to reduce the conservatism of the robust optimization problem using an uncertain budget, and then solves the problem using the column constraint generation method. Finally, the modified IEEE-33 node is used as an example to validate the developed model. The simulation results show that the robust optimization method can better solve the problems caused by the uncertainty factors of distributed power and load, and the robust optimization reduces 177.9kWh on average compared with the deterministic optimization in the worst scenario.

articleTitle: Design of a multi-mode intelligent drive stroke rehabilitation robot based on limb linkage structure
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Adequate rehabilitation training after stroke can effectively improve patients’ quality of life and reduce the rate of secondary recurrence. Intelligent rehabilitation robots have excellent research value because they can adjust the rehabilitation process through human-computer interaction. In order to solve the problem of patients’ lack of exercise initiative in rehabilitation training, this paper proposes a dual-driven control strategy of adaptive heart rate regulation and transcranial electrical stimulation to effectively help patients complete the corresponding training tasks and develop a multi-mode intelligent drive rehabilitation robot based on limb linkage structure. The device collects individual cardiopulmonary function data through sensors and multi-modally senses the individual’s physiological condition, according to which quantitative resistance output response is made. It uses transcranial electrical stimulation as a supplementary adjustment mechanism for motion feedback and establishes a heart rate adjustment movement and motion adaptation that adapts to the ontology feeling and can achieve the effect of active movement—a two-way collaborative model of heart rate and actual physiological conditions. The experimental results show that the electromagnetic resistance under different gears and pressure can adjust the output resistance more sensitively. At the same time, the two test results show that the gear adjustment brings a good sense of experience. The movement under the regulation of different output resistances is well adapted to the heart rate, and the corresponding body feeling aligns with the RPE amount table, with a good rehabilitation application effect.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Autonomous Control System for Simulated Fixed-Wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), the demand for enhancing UAV intelligence has become a prominent trend. To improve UAV automation, flight control systems are required to enable autonomous flight without human operators. Currently, UAV flight control primarily relies on two methods: PID control and rule-based control, each with its own limitations. With advancements in reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms and computational capabilities, researchers have increasingly explored the potential of agents trained through RL to perform complex flight control tasks. This paper is dedicated to the design and implementation of an autonomous flight control system for fixed-wing UAVs. It leverages JSBSim’s aerodynamic simulator and the OpenAI Gym interface, allowing users to create various flight control tasks and design different deep RL models using RLlib, to learn corresponding optimal control strategies. The specific task we implemented to keep F16 in a steady level flight showcases the system’s capabilities to build a simulation environment, model and train the agent, and learn optimal policies using PPO. Experimental findings confirm our system’s scalability and adaptability to a wide range of flight control tasks and demonstrate the above task’s robust performance throughout the learning and testing phases.

articleTitle: Research on Sound Source Localization and Path Planning with SLAM Maps
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: A technical solution that combines the sound source localization with SLAM maps was proposed to realize the mapping of the sound source coordinates to the SLAM maps. Meanwhile, aiming at the low positioning accuracy and poor real-time performance of the sound source localization algorithms, the improvements to the traditional SRP-PHAT sound source localization algorithm were made. The microphone directivity model and hierarchical searching strategy were adopted to reduce the computational load, and the MSW automatic calibration mechanism was added to ensure the accuracy of sound source localization. After obtaining the direction and angle information of the sound source quickly and accurately, the accurate localization of the sound source target in the SLAM global map was realized by combining displacement measurement and coordinate conversion. Besides, an optimized A* path planning algorithm with a diagonal no-passing strategy was proposed to realize the path planning from the robot to the sound source target based on the SLAM map, which improve the reliability of obstacle avoidance to a certain extent. The experiment results show that effectiveness and superiority of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A Congestion Sub-area Coordinated Control Model for Queue Suppression Based on Improved Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Robotics, Automation and Intelligent Control (ICRAIC)
abstract: Iterative optimization of signal control timing is an significant way to alleviate urban traffic congestion. In order to ensure the stability of traffic operation under traffic congestion, this paper constructed a coordinated control algorithm for congestion sub-area facing queue suppression. By introducing path traffic flow and path length indicators, a method for selecting critical traffic paths under congestion conditions was proposed. A coordinated control model for congestion sub-area was established, with the optimization goal of maximizing the throughout traffic volume of critical traffic paths and minimizing the increment of maximum queue length in sub-area.
